name.en-US: The Perfection of Life, for Sisters
name.pt-BR: A perfeição da vida, para as irmãs

description.la: Epistola ad sororem sanctae Claram, de perfectione vitae, in octo capitibus: de cognitione sui, humilitate, paupertate, silentio, oratione, memoria passionis, caritate et perseverantia. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Decem opuscula, 1900), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A letter of spiritual direction to a Poor Clare in eight chapters: self-knowledge, humility, poverty, silence, prayer, the memory of the Passion, charity and final perseverance. The Latin is the Quaracchi text of the Decem opuscula (1900), from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Carta de direção espiritual a uma clarissa em oito capítulos: conhecimento de si, humildade, pobreza, silêncio, oração, memória da Paixão, caridade e perseverança final.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Decem opuscula ad theologiam mysticam spectantia, ed. 2 (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1900).
sources.description: Archive.org OCR of the octavo edition. Page heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings and cross-references) and note markers are removed; line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by comparison with the other Quaracchi scans, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1900 is public domain.
